title: Sengoku Rance: Before the Battle
alt: A man in green armor and a white cape stands on a grassy hill with his back to the viewer and holds a dark sword up to the sun. A woman with pink hair stands beside him, clay creatures cheer in the grass, and a Japanese castle stands among cherry trees above two armies.
summary: A painting of a scene from Sengoku Rance in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is a spring morning in JAPAN, the country of Sengoku Rance. Sengoku Rance is a game by AliceSoft. Rance holds the sword Chaos up to the sun, and Sill stands next to him.
Four Hannies cheer in the grass. Two armies stand on the plain below a castle with cherry trees. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
